title: 3EN002 + Pi-hole diagnostic output return test
description: Read-only network diagnostics from Windows 11, designed to verify that v3.4 uploads both step status JSON and the full stdout transcript. No configuration changes are made.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Host '=== 3EN NETWORK DIAGNOSTIC 009 ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- ROUTER 192.168.1.2 ---'; Write-Host ('PING='+(Test-Connection -ComputerName '192.168.1.2' -Count 2 -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)); foreach($p in 22,53,80,443){$t=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '192.168.1.2' -Port $p -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('TCP_'+$p+'='+$t.TcpTestSucceeded)}; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- DNS ---'; $dns=(Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.ServerAddresses.Count -gt 0} | ForEach-Object {$_.ServerAddresses} | Sort-Object -Unique); foreach($d in $dns){Write-Host ('DNS_SERVER='+$d)}; try{$r=Resolve-DnsName 'google.com' -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Write-Host ('GOOGLE_A='+($r -join ','))}catch{Write-Host ('GOOGLE_A=FAIL '+$_.Exception.Message)}; try{$pih=Resolve-DnsName 'pi.hole' -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Write-Host ('PIHOLE_A='+($pih -join ','))}catch{Write-Host ('PIHOLE_A=FAIL '+$_.Exception.Message)}; Write-Host ''; $gw=Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 1; if($gw){Write-Host ('DEFAULT_GATEWAY='+$gw.NextHop);Write-Host ('INTERFACE_INDEX='+$gw.InterfaceIndex)}else{Write-Host 'DEFAULT_GATEWAY=NONE'}
